title: Tell HN: Server Status
guide_zh: HN 长时间离线后，维护者介绍硬件排查与替换机器的进展。
author: kogir
excerpt: HN went down for nearly all of Monday the 6th. I suspected failing hardware. I configured a new machine that is nearly identical to the old one, but using ZFS instead of UFS.
